name: plus-one-daily
description: Learn your way. One useful, personalised lesson every day in just a few minutes.

interface.shortDescription: Learn your way — one useful lesson, every day.
interface.longDescription: Quick, personalised learning inside ChatGPT. +1 uses relevant context available to ChatGPT to choose something worth learning next, teaches it in a focused 3–5 minute experience, and builds a Capability Passport of what you can now do, understand, recognise, or explain.
defaultPrompt: Make today's +1 relevant to what I've been working on.
